# ToggleButton

ToggleButton is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { ToggleButton } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Action
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/action-togglebutton--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Bold01 as Bold } from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import { ThemeProvider, ToggleButton } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ToggleButtonExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <ToggleButton aria-label="Toggle bold">
        <Bold className="h-4 w-4" />
      </ToggleButton>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## ToggleButton

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `ToggleButtonProps`, which extends `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof TogglePrimitive.Root>`.

- `variant`: `"default" | "outline"`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `size`: `"default" | "sm" | "lg"`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `pressed`: `boolean`, optional.

  The controlled state of the toggle.

- `defaultPressed`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  The state of the toggle when initially rendered. Use `defaultPressed`
  if you do not need to control the state of the toggle.

- `onPressedChange`: `(pressed: boolean) => void`, optional.

  The callback that fires when the state of the toggle changes.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 273 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
